propositions: The code-review-verify spec emits only {verifications: [...]} with no verdict/finding polarity, causing _verdict_decision to always map output to advisory regardless of gold label.

Both V-real-defect (gold block) and V-clean-rename (gold advisory) emit non-empty verifications lists, so mapping presence to block would fix one recall miss while manufacturing a false accept on the clean case.

code-review-verify must be excluded from the parity corpus by a separate named mechanism distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS to prevent future maintainers from collapsing the two exclusion reasons and re-admitting mis-scored cases.

Offline re-scoring after exclusion raises n_gold from 28 to 26, lifts recall on both standard and frontier arms, and leaves all gating verdicts unchanged because the miss was symmetric and the affected case is gold-block not safe.
